archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Infinity Nikki Details Version 3.0

entries.headline: Infinity Nikki Details Version 3.0's Twin Cities and New Combat Systems
entries.summary: The PlayStation Blog details Cicia, Ceremius, new exploration abilities, and firearm and magic combat, and says the update would reach PS5 later on November 26 Pacific time.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog page supports the version, features, platform, and relative launch timing.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp converts to 05:59 Beijing time on November 27.

entries.headline: HITMAN World of Assassination Launches The Mutiny Elusive Target
entries.summary: Lenny Kravitz plays Bawma from 007 First Light in the global limited-time mission, available through December 24.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire page confirms the character, performer, dates, and listed platforms.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp converts to 22:00 Beijing time on November 26.

entries.headline: Showa American Story Delayed Again to October 28, 2027
entries.summary: NEKCOM Entertainment says core development is complete but more time is needed for quality improvements; creative director Luo Xiangyu says the project was rebuilt repeatedly to reach an acceptable result.
entries.verification: 4Gamer and Famitsu relay the identifiable official delay; 4Gamer also relays the director's public explanation.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer timestamp converts to 15:57 Beijing time on November 26.

entries.headline: Monster Hunter Now Developers Discuss the Osaka Event and Development Structure
entries.summary: AUTOMATON interviews Scopely Explore's Sakae Osumi and Capcom's Genki Sunano about the roaming Osaka event, three years of operation, train-play support, and the post-acquisition development structure.
entries.verification: The opened interview identifies both developers and the scope of their comments.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp converts to 20:23 Beijing time on November 26.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI: GTA VI's Lucia Actor Issues Her First Statement Since Launch
entries.summary: Manni L. Perez says she spent nearly a decade bringing Lucia to life and thanks players for their response to the game.
entries.verification: IGN relays Perez's identifiable public social-media statement.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp converts to 05:02 Beijing time on November 27.

entries.headline: Funghi Days Announced for Consoles
entries.summary: SUCCESS Corporation announces a new console game for the Nameko/Funghi series' 15th anniversary; specific platforms and a release date remain unannounced.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays the identifiable SUCCESS Corporation announcement and preserves the unknown platform and date fields.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp converts to 11:22 Beijing time on November 26.

entries.headline: Slay the Spire 2 Researchers Explain AlphaDefect's 80%+ Win Rate
entries.summary: AUTOMATON interviews co-author Junpei Komiyama about the reinforcement-learning system, which exceeded an 80% win rate in Ascension 10 tests after 14.2 billion decisions.
entries.verification: The opened interview supports the researcher identity, test scope, training scale, and stated limitations.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp converts to 08:52 Beijing time on November 27.
